```{=html}
/* Comparator Component Styling */
.comparator-hero {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e3a8a 100%);
  color: #ffffff;
  padding: 2.2rem 2rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.3);
}

.comparator-hero-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.85rem;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  border-radius: 9999px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  color: #93c5fd;
}

.comparator-title {
  font-size: 1.85rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.comparator-desc {
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  color: #cbd5e1;
  max-width: 900px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* Control Panel */
.comp-control-panel {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.comp-section-title {
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #475569;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.comp-preset-bar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.preset-chip {
  padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  background: #f8fafc;
  color: #1e293b;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.preset-chip:hover {
  background: #eff6ff;
  border-color: #3b82f6;
  color: #1d4ed8;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.preset-chip.active {
  background: #1e3a8a;
  border-color: #1e3a8a;
  color: #ffffff;
}

.ex-select-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(170px, 1fr));
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.ex-pill {
  padding: 0.45rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  background: #ffffff;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  user-select: none;
}

.ex-pill:hover {
  border-color: #93c5fd;
  background: #f0fdf4;
}

.ex-pill.selected {
  background: #eff6ff;
  border-color: #2563eb;
  color: #1e3a8a;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #2563eb;
}

.ex-pill .pill-check {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: #2563eb;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.ex-pill.selected .pill-check {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Category Tabs & Options Bar */
.comp-options-bar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding-top: 1rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
}

.comp-tabs {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.35rem;
}

.comp-tab-btn {
  padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background: transparent;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #64748b;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.comp-tab-btn:hover {
  color: #1e293b;
  background: #f1f5f9;
}

.comp-tab-btn.active {
  background: #1e3a8a;
  color: #ffffff;
}

.comp-toggles {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.toggle-label {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #475569;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Comparison Matrix Container */
.comparison-matrix-wrapper {
  overflow-x: auto;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.comp-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: separate;
  border-spacing: 0;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.comp-table th, .comp-table td {
  padding: 0.85rem 1.1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  border-right: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  vertical-align: top;
}

.comp-table th:last-child, .comp-table td:last-child {
  border-right: none;
}

.comp-table tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.comp-header-row th {
  background: #f8fafc;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 10;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #cbd5e1;
}

.comp-attr-col {
  width: 220px;
  min-width: 200px;
  background: #f8fafc;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #334155;
  border-right: 2px solid #e2e8f0 !important;
}

.comp-ex-header {
  min-width: 260px;
  padding: 1.2rem 1rem !important;
  text-align: left;
}

.comp-ex-header.featured-krx {
  background: #eff6ff !important;
  border-top: 3px solid #2563eb;
}

.comp-header-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #0f172a;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
}

.comp-header-sub {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: #64748b;
  margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
}

.comp-header-links {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.comp-link-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.55rem;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  background: #e2e8f0;
  color: #334155;
  transition: var(--transition);
}

.comp-link-btn:hover {
  background: #2563eb;
  color: #ffffff;
}

.comp-group-header {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #1e3a8a;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  padding: 0.6rem 1.1rem !important;
}

.comp-diff-highlight {
  background: #fefce8 !important;
}

.comp-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
}

.badge-lead {
  background: #dcfce7;
  color: #15803d;
}

.badge-lag {
  background: #fee2e2;
  color: #b91c1c;
}

.badge-neutral {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  color: #475569;
}

.empty-state {
  padding: 3rem;
  text-align: center;
  color: #64748b;
}

// Current Active State
let selectedExchanges = ["krx", "nextrade"];
let activeCategory = "all";

// Initialization
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  initPicker();
  renderMatrix();
});

function initPicker() {
  const container = document.getElementById("exchangePicker");
  container.innerHTML = "";
  
  for (const [id, data] of Object.entries(EXCHANGES_DB)) {
    const pill = document.createElement("div");
    pill.className = `ex-pill ${selectedExchanges.includes(id) ? 'selected' : ''}`;
    pill.id = `pill_${id}`;
    pill.onclick = () => toggleExchange(id);
    
    pill.innerHTML = `
      <span>${data.name}</span>
      <span class="pill-check">✓</span>
    `;
    container.appendChild(pill);
  }
}

function toggleExchange(id) {
  if (selectedExchanges.includes(id)) {
    if (selectedExchanges.length <= 1) {
      alert("최소 1개 이상의 거래소를 선택해야 합니다.");
      return;
    }
    selectedExchanges = selectedExchanges.filter(e => e !== id);
  } else {
    if (selectedExchanges.length >= 4) {
      alert("화면 가독성을 위해 한 번에 최대 4개 거래소까지 비교를 권장합니다.");
      return;
    }
    selectedExchanges.push(id);
  }
  
  updatePills();
  renderMatrix();
}

function updatePills() {
  for (const id of Object.keys(EXCHANGES_DB)) {
    const pill = document.getElementById(`pill_${id}`);
    if (pill) {
      if (selectedExchanges.includes(id)) {
        pill.classList.add("selected");
      } else {
        pill.classList.remove("selected");
      }
    }
  }
}

function applyPreset(presetKey) {
  // Update preset button active class
  document.querySelectorAll(".preset-chip").forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove("active"));
  event.target.classList.add("active");

  if (presetKey === "kr_nxt") {
    selectedExchanges = ["krx", "nextrade"];
  } else if (presetKey === "asia4") {
    selectedExchanges = ["krx", "jpx", "hkex", "sgx"];
  } else if (presetKey === "global_equity") {
    selectedExchanges = ["krx", "nyse", "nasdaq"];
  } else if (presetKey === "derivatives") {
    selectedExchanges = ["krx", "cme", "deutsche_borse"];
  } else if (presetKey === "clearing") {
    selectedExchanges = ["ksd", "dtcc", "jpx", "deutsche_borse"];
  }
  
  updatePills();
  renderMatrix();
}

function resetSelection() {
  selectedExchanges = ["krx"];
  document.querySelectorAll(".preset-chip").forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove("active"));
  updatePills();
  renderMatrix();
}

function setCategory(cat, btn) {
  activeCategory = cat;
  document.querySelectorAll(".comp-tab-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
  btn.classList.add("active");
  renderMatrix();
}

// Field Definitions
const ATTRIBUTES = [
  // General Info
  { key: "country", label: "국가 및 소재지", cat: "trading" },
  { key: "type", label: "시장 구조 및 유형", cat: "trading" },
  
  // IT & Engine
  { key: "engine", label: "매매/청산 엔진 (아키텍처)", cat: "it" },
  { key: "latency", label: "지연시간 (Latency)", cat: "it" },
  { key: "throughput", label: "처리량 및 용량 (Throughput)", cat: "it" },
  { key: "dltCloud", label: "클라우드 및 DLT 혁신", cat: "it" },
  
  // Trading & Orders
  { key: "tradingHours", label: "정규 매매시간", cat: "trading" },
  { key: "nightTrading", label: "야간 및 연장 거래 세션", cat: "trading" },
  { key: "orderTypes", label: "호가 유형 (Order Types)", cat: "trading" },
  { key: "tickSize", label: "호가단위 (Tick Size)", cat: "trading" },
  { key: "atsCompetition", label: "ATS/다크풀 경쟁 및 SOR", cat: "trading" },

  // Volatility & Risk
  { key: "volatilityCtrl", label: "변동성 제어 및 서킷브레이커", cat: "risk" },
  
  // Post-Trade & Clearing
  { key: "settlementCycle", label: "결제주기 (Settlement Cycle)", cat: "clearing" },
  { key: "clearingCCP", label: "청산기관 (CCP 구조)", cat: "clearing" },
  { key: "marginModel", label: "증거금 산정 모델 (Margin)", cat: "clearing" }
];

function renderMatrix() {
  const container = document.getElementById("matrixContainer");
  const highlightDiff = document.getElementById("diffHighlightToggle").checked;

  if (selectedExchanges.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state">선택된 거래소가 없습니다. 상단에서 비교할 거래소를 선택해주세요.</div>`;
    return;
  }

  // Filter attributes based on active tab
  const visibleAttrs = ATTRIBUTES.filter(attr => activeCategory === "all" || attr.cat === activeCategory);

  let html = `<table class="comp-table">`;
  
  // Header Row
  html += `<tr class="comp-header-row">`;
  html += `<th class="comp-attr-col" style="font-size:0.86rem; color:#64748b;">비교 항목 / 지표</th>`;
  
  for (const exId of selectedExchanges) {
    const ex = EXCHANGES_DB[exId];
    const isKrx = exId === "krx";
    html += `
      <th class="comp-ex-header ${isKrx ? 'featured-krx' : ''}">
        <div class="comp-header-title">
          <span>${ex.name}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="comp-header-sub">${ex.nativeName} · ${ex.country}</div>
        <div class="comp-header-links">
          <a href="${ex.reportKo}" class="comp-link-btn" title="한국어 심층 보고서 읽기">📄 상세분석</a>
          <a href="${ex.reportEn}" class="comp-link-btn" title="영문 보고서 읽기">🌐 EN</a>
        </div>
      </th>
    `;
  }
  html += `</tr>`;

  // Body Rows
  for (const attr of visibleAttrs) {
    // Check if values differ across selected exchanges
    const values = selectedExchanges.map(exId => EXCHANGES_DB[exId][attr.key]);
    const isDifferent = new Set(values).size > 1;
    const rowClass = (highlightDiff && isDifferent) ? 'comp-diff-highlight' : '';

    html += `<tr class="${rowClass}">`;
    html += `<td class="comp-attr-col">${attr.label}</td>`;

    for (const exId of selectedExchanges) {
      const val = EXCHANGES_DB[exId][attr.key] || "-";
      // Format line breaks
      const formattedVal = val.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
      html += `<td>${formattedVal}</td>`;
    }
    html += `</tr>`;
  }

  html += `</table>`;
  container.innerHTML = html;
}
</script>
```

### 💡 KRX 벤치마킹 시사점 (Key Strategic Takeaways)

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
#### 📌 1. 대체거래소(Nextrade ATS) 복수 경쟁 체제 대응
2025년 3월 넥스트레이드 출범 및 10~15% 거래대금 안착에 따라, KRX는 중간가호가 및 스톱지정가 등 신규 호가 유형을 도입하고 메이커-테이커(Maker-Taker) 수수료를 정교화하여 대응하고 있습니다. 증권사 SOR(최선집행엔진)이 양 시장의 가격을 실시간으로 비교하므로 체결 속도와 호가창 유동성 수호가 핵심 과제입니다.
:::

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
#### 📌 2. 결제주기(T+1) 단축 및 분할결제 정착
미국·캐나다(2024년 5월 완료)와 인도(2023년)가 이미 주식 T+1을 시행 중이며, 유럽연합(EU)도 2027년 10월 T+1 단축을 확정했습니다. 한국은 2026년 4월 10억 원 단위 분할결제 제도를 성공적으로 안착시켜 결제유동성 리스크를 크게 낮추었으며, 글로벌 정합성을 위한 T+1 중장기 로드맵을 적극 추진하고 있습니다.
:::

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}
#### 📌 3. 차세대 증거금 방법론 (SPAN → VaR/ES) 전환 흐름
CME(SPAN 2), Eurex(PRISMA), DTCC 및 일본 JSCC(2023년 VaR 전환 완료) 등 글로벌 주요 CCP는 과거 시나리오 기반의 SPAN에서 3세대 VaR/Expected Shortfall 프레임워크로 전면 전환했습니다. KRX 역시 JSCC의 선례를 참고하여 장내 파생상품 증거금 체계의 VaR 고도화를 추진할 시점입니다.
:::
